state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 4 (Syntax) is in progress: "Start here", the four Basics pages and the ten "Values and types" pages are written.**

`tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` `syntaxProblems` is the `syntax` part, tested in `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. Every Syntax page except `syntax/index.mdx` needs a non-empty `covers:`, a `<Snippet>` and a `## Do and don't` list.

On disk: `website/src/content/docs/syntax/start-here.mdx`, `syntax/basics/*.mdx` and `syntax/values/{numbers,strings,bool-and-null,arrays,nullable,union-types,enums,as,is,tainted-and-secret}.mdx`. Snippets sit flat under `website/snippets/syntax/<page>/`, with no `basics/` or `values/` level. Sidebar entries are in `website/astro.config.ts`, stamps in `website/site.lock.json`. The enums page also covers all 34 Core enums. Start here covers `lang:types/what-does-not-exist`.

`site structure`, `stale` and `reference` pass. `site syntax` reports 115 uncovered features. Four `lang:types/*` sections are left for later pages: `callable-classes-object-shapes` and `properties-and-constants` go to Classes, and `parameters` and `void-never-self-static` go to Functions. The Throwable tree goes to Errors. `Comparable`, `Stringable`, `Parses` and `PropertyObserver` go to Classes (interfaces). `Iterable` and `Iterator` go to the iteration page. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on pages that stages 5 and 6 rewrite.

items.text: **Operators**: arithmetic, comparison, `??` and `??=`, string operators, precedence. Covers `lang:expressions/*`. Goal § Stage 4. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/30-expressions.md:8`, `website/astro.config.ts:139`

**Control flow**: if, match, loops and foreach, break and continue. Covers `lang:statements/*` except try, catch and throw, and `lang:iteration/*` with `Iterable` and `Iterator`. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/40-statements.md:43`, `docs/reference/lang/60-iteration.md:1`

**Errors**: throw and catch, error types, checked returns. Covers `lang:errors/*`, the try, catch and throw sections of the statements chapter, and the `Throwable` tree ids. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/70-errors.md:8`

backlog: Functions pages (goal § Stage 4): must cover `lang:types/parameters` and `lang:types/void-never-self-static`.

Classes and objects pages: must cover `lang:types/callable-classes-object-shapes`, `lang:types/properties-and-constants` and the Core interfaces `Comparable`, `Stringable`, `Parses`, `PropertyObserver`.
Programs and files, Special syntax, concurrency, attributes and testing pages (goal § Stage 4).
